kazakhstan:KZ-BAIKONUR.name: Baikonur
kazakhstan:KZ-BAIKONUR.note: Kazakhstan city with special status, leased to Russia as part of the Baikonur complex until 2050. Shown separately for map selection; KATO places it within Kyzylorda Region. The mapped 2024 city boundary is distinct from the much larger cosmodrome lease area. No comparable separate population total is provided.
